title: The Lamborghini Countach is a legendary
description_it: The Lamborghini Countach is a legendary Italian supercar produced between 1974 and 1990, renowned for its futuristic design and high-performance capabilities. Styled by Marcello Gandini of Bertone, it introduced the world to the now-iconic wedge-shaped body and scissor doors, which became trademarks of Lamborghini. Equipped with a powerful V12 engine, the Countach delivered thrilling speed and handling, pushing the boundaries of automotive engineering of its time. Its aggressive styling, low-slung profile, and raw driving experience made it an icon of the 1980s and a dream car for generations of enthusiasts.
